step1_figure.circuit_type: DRAM Open Bit-Line Sense Amplifier with Equilibration Circuitry, NMOS Sense Amplifier (NSA), PMOS Sense Amplifier (PSA), and 1T1C Memory Cells
step1_figure.description: Figure 16.10 illustrates the connection of the NMOS sense amplifier (M1-M2, MPD), bitline equilibration switches (ME1-ME3), column capacitances, and access transistors with DRAM storage cells (Cmbit). Figure 16.13 adds the complementary PMOS sense amplifier (PSA) with active pull-up switch to restore the high bitline to VDD.

equilibrated_bitline_voltage.description: Precharge/equilibration voltage on bitlines prior to sensing

equation.explanation: When the Eq signal is asserted, ME1-ME3 short the complementary bitlines together and to the VDD/2 precharge reference.
equation.assumptions: Equal bitline capacitances Ccol_array0 = Ccol_array1 = 100 fF

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDDby2 = 0.5 V (as specified in textbook and netlist), V_EQ = 0.5 V. In standard SKY130 1.8V operation, V_EQ = VDD/2 = 0.9 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Driven by VDDby2 low-impedance precharge rail during equilibration phase.

charge_sharing_total_charge.description: Total charge present on storage cell capacitor and bitline capacitance before access transistor turns on

equation.explanation: Charge on the cell capacitor plus the precharged bitline capacitance before wordline activation.
equation.assumptions: C_mbit = 20 fF, C_col = 100 fF, V_mbit = 1.0 V, VDD/2 = 0.5 V

sky130_expected.reasoning: Conservative charge sharing equation based on nominal 20 fF cell and 100 fF digit line.

bitline_voltage_final.description: Bitline voltage after wordline asserts and charge sharing occurs between Cmbit and Ccol

equation.explanation: Conservation of charge when access transistor turns on, equalizing voltage across Cmbit and Ccol.
equation.assumptions: C_mbit = 20 fF, C_col = 100 fF, V_mbit = 1.0 V, V_EQ = 0.5 V

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined strictly by the capacitance ratio C_mbit / (C_mbit + C_col_array) = 1/6.

delta_v_bit.description: Differential voltage developed on the bitline during read before sensing

equation.explanation: Voltage delta between the active bitline and the reference bitline (which stays at VDD/2).
equation.assumptions: C_mbit = 20 fF, C_col = 100 fF, V_mbit = 1.0 V, VDD/2 = 0.5 V

sky130_expected.reasoning: Must exceed the sense amplifier offset voltage (typically 20-30 mV) for reliable sensing.

sensing_power_avg.description: Average dynamic power dissipated per sense amplifier during active cycling

equation.explanation: Dynamic power dissipated charging one column capacitance from VDD/2 to VDD per sensing cycle.
equation.assumptions: N_SA = 1, C_col = 100 fF, VDD/2 = 0.5 V, cycle time = 30 ns (f = 33.3 MHz)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct consequence of bitline capacitive charge/discharge at 33.3 MHz operation.

wordline_delay.description: RC propagation delay through a distributed polysilicon word line across the memory array

equation.explanation: Total wordline distributed RC delay where total capacitance is N_col*(Cox + Cparasitic) and total resistance is N_col*Rgate.
equation.assumptions: N_col = 512, Cox = 400 aF, C_parasitic = 100 aF, R_gate = 4 ohm

sky130_expected.reasoning: Representative distributed RC delay for a 512-column memory block as analyzed on page 443.

nsa_sensing_delay.description: Evaluation time from sense_N rising until the reference bitline drops to ground (logic 0)

equation.explanation: Delay of regenerative cross-coupled NMOS pair pulling the lower bitline to 0.

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 with W/L=1u/0.15u and Ccol=100fF, discharge time t_nsa is typically 1.0 to 2.5 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the drive capability of cross-coupled NMOS devices xm2/xm3 and footer xm1.

psa_restore_delay.description: Time from sense_p asserting low until the active bitline restores to full VDD (logic 1)

equation.explanation: Active pull-up time of cross-coupled PMOS pair restoring the cell capacitor back to full logic 1.

sky130_expected.calculation: PMOS mobility is ~1/4 of NMOS. With W_p=2u, charging 100 fF from 0.58 V to 1.62 V takes ~2.0 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: PMOS pull-up path charges bitline0 and refreshes Cmbit0.

bitline_differential_swing.description: Final differential output voltage between bitline0 and bitline1 after complete sensing and restoration

equation.explanation: Full rail-to-rail differential voltage once both NSA and PSA have fired.

sky130_expected.calculation: V(bitline0) restored to VDD = 1.8 V, V(bitline1) discharged to GND = 0 V -> Delta_V_out = 1.8 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cross-coupled latch regenerates fully to the supply rails.

step3_testbench.description: Transient simulation of DRAM sense amplifier performing read, sense, and refresh operations of a logic 1 cell, matching Baker Chapter 16 timing and figures.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DRAM Sense Amplifier Testbench (Baker CMOS Ch 16)
.lib "/home/designer/shared/pdk/sky130A/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=1.0u  L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=1.0u  L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=1.0u  L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=1.0u  L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.0u  L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1.0u  L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=1.0u  L_xm7=0.15u
.param W_xm8=1.0u  L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=2.0u  L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=2.0u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=2.0u L_xm11=0.15u

* DUT Instance
xm1 NLAT sense_N 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
VDD VDD 0 1.8
VDDby2 VDDby2 0 500mV
xm2 bitline1 bitline0 NLAT 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 bitline0 bitline1 NLAT 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 bitline1 Eq bitline0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm5 bitline0 Eq VDDby2 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 VDDby2 Eq bitline1 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
Ccol1 bitline1 0 1e-13
Ccol0 bitline0 0 1e-13
xm7 bitline0 ra0 mb0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
Cmbit0 mb0 0 2e-14
xm8 bitline1 ra1 mb1 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
Cmbit1 mb1 0 2e-14
Vsn1 ra1 0 0
xm9 ACT sense_p VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 bitline1 bitline0 ACT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
xm11 bitline0 bitline1 ACT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}

* Control Signal Stimuli (Matching Baker Figure 16.14)
* Eq: High from 0 to 5 ns to equilibrate bitlines to VDD/2
VEq Eq 0 pwl(0 1.8 4.9n 1.8 5.1n 0 30n 0)
* ra0: Word line array0 turns on at 7 ns (access DRAM cell)
Vra0 ra0 0 pwl(0 0 6.9n 0 7.1n 1.8 30n 1.8)
* sense_N: NSA fires at 12 ns
Vsense_N sense_N 0 pwl(0 0 11.9n 0 12.1n 1.8 30n 1.8)
* sense_p: PSA fires at 15 ns (active low)
Vsense_p sense_p 0 pwl(0 1.8 14.9n 1.8 15.1n 0 30n 0)

* Initial conditions
.ic v(bitline0)=250m v(bitline1)=750m v(mb0)=1.0

.control
tran 10p 30n uic

* Measure equilibration voltage at t = 5.0 ns
meas tran v_eq find v(bitline0) at=5.0n

* Measure voltage after charge sharing at t = 11.5 ns (before NSA fires)
meas tran v_final find v(bitline0) at=11.5n

* Calculate delta V bitline
let delta_v = v_final - v_eq
print delta_v

* Measure final bitline voltages after sensing
meas tran v_bl0_end find v(bitline0) at=28n
meas tran v_bl1_end find v(bitline1) at=28n
let diff_swing = v_bl0_end - v_bl1_end
print diff_swing

* Measure NSA sensing delay (reference bitline falling below 0.2V)
meas tran t_nsa trig v(sense_N) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(bitline1) val=0.2 fall=1

* Measure PSA restore delay (active bitline rising above 1.6V)
meas tran t_psa trig v(sense_p) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(bitline0) val=1.6 rise=1

quit
.endc
.end
